description: Relay mode settings. Maps to mautrix bridgev2/bridgeconfig.RelayConfig.

enabled.description: Enable relay mode for bridging messages from non-logged-in users.

admin_only.description: Only allow admins to enable relay mode in a room.

prefer_default.description: Prefer default relays over room-specific relays.

default_relays.description: Default user login IDs to use for relaying.

message_formats.description: Go text/template strings for formatting relayed messages, keyed by message type (e.g. 'm.text').

displayname_format.description: Go text/template string for formatting relayed displaynames.
